answer: A refundable stake tied to a durable identity works like a juniper hedge: each agent must lock a small deposit before it can enter the market through the single public inlet, and the deposit is slashed if peers later prove the agent is a duplicate. A verification market prices the stake in onyx-grade reputation: new identities start with zero reputation and earn trust only through attested work, so an attacker must pay the stake and do real work for every fake identity, while honest agents keep their deposit and reputation. Sybil volume becomes expensive instead of free.
